args.summary: Deployed checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the unhealthy v2.3.1 release, which was running at an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 is now healthy with error rate reduced to ~0.2%. This incident records the hotfix deployment.
args.title: Hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to checkout-api production to resolve v2.3.1 regression

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Assessed the situation**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in production, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate across all regions. v2.3.2 had never been deployed to production.
2. **Deployed v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — routed through change-manager approval per policy since it was a first-time release, and the rollout was verified.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: v2.3.2 is healthy in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the hotfix deployment and the v2.3.1 regression it remediated.
